text: **Validation duty is the component most often omitted, and its omission is not benign.** A participant assigned a verification task without the corresponding duty — and, critically, without the ZOV to discharge it — will produce a plausible answer rather than declining. §12.4.1 documents an instance from this project's own preparation. §9.5 develops the design consequence.
